comment: Frame generation generic binding: any game on game-interface 2.x from 2.4 on (major 2, minor 4 or later) that has no title binding of its own. The interface's export names (roles) and the shared structure GUIDs (viewport, tag, resource, constants, requirements) are the RR binding's for 2.14 (interface_binding): the same names and GUIDs in every 2.x build the RR plugin serves (2.7, 2.8, 2.14); a role an older interface does not export is simply not hooked. The FG options and state are taken from structure version 1 on and read only up to the version the game passes (the codec, win32/fg_sl214_codec.h); the sizes name the codec's full layouts. The game's DXGI factory: through the interface's own factory export when the game imports it, otherwise the exe's imports of the DXGI module's factory creations (dxgi_factory_fallback). Read at configure time by ../CMakeLists.txt (generated header in the build tree; never edited by hand).
title: game interface 2.x (generic)
